research_brief.question: Can a safety-constrained, uncertainty-aware Pareto acquisition policy select practical pigment-novelty candidates more efficiently than random and color-distance-only selection?
research_brief.hypothesis: The multiobjective policy has a higher future measured novelty-gate pass rate than prespecified baselines.
research_brief.scientific_object: Candidate material library and declared reference pigment library.
alternative_explanations: The predicted improvement is a proxy mismatch.
Composition/safety review invalidates the apparent winner.
falsification_conditions: No baseline improvement at equal budget.
No candidate passes all gates after future measurement.
Eligible set is emptied by mandatory review.

requires: CIEDE2000 separation under primary and secondary illuminants
constraint pass or human review clearance

primary_endpoint: Future measured all-gate pass proportion at equal selection budget.
needs_human_input: Application-specific reference library and eligible comparator rules.
Institutional composition, safety, and waste constraints.
Numerical novelty, utility, and uncertainty thresholds.
Future authorised measurement protocol and resources.
